overview_description.description: Bland AI provides a voice AI platform that enables organizations to build, deploy, and manage automated phone agents for inbound and outbound conversations. The platform supports voice calls, SMS, web chat, and messaging channels while maintaining shared context across customer interactions. It includes tools for conversation design, workflow testing, call monitoring, integrations with CRM, scheduling, and telephony systems, as well as APIs for custom development. Bland AI also offers voice cloning, multilingual communication capabilities, security controls, compliance-focused features, and deployment options designed for industries that handle regulated customer communications.

about_short_description.short_description: Bland AI enables organizations to build, deploy, and manage automated phone agents for inbound and outbound conversations.

product.name: Bland AI Phone Agents
product.description: AI-powered phone agents that simulate human conversation, support multiple languages, and operate continuously to handle sales, scheduling, and customer support calls.

product.name: Pathways
product.description: A programming language for designing AI conversation workflows that map out dialogue and decision-making to guide AI phone agents' interactions.

product.name: Bland API and Integrations
product.description: APIs that enable dynamic data exchange between Bland AI agents and external business systems for seamless workflow automation.

product.name: Dedicated Infrastructure for Enterprises
product.description: Self-hosted infrastructure offering high uptime, security, and scalability to support large-scale AI phone call operations.

product.name: Security and Compliance Services
product.description: Security measures and compliance protocols to protect customer data and ensure privacy in AI phone call operations.
